nodes.summary: Every even perfect number $N$ is of the form $N = 2^{p-1}(2^p - 1)$ for some natural number $p$ such that $p$ and $2^p - 1$ are both prime.
nodes.title: Euler's theorem on even perfect numbers

nodes.summary: Let $\sigma(n)$ denote the sum of the positive divisors of $n$. A natural number $n$ is extremely abundant if either $n = 10080$, or $n > 10080$ and $\sigma(n) / (n \log \log n) > \sigma(m) / (m \log \log m)$ for every natural number $m$ with $10080 \le m < n$, where $\log$ is the natural logarithm.
nodes.title: Extremely abundant number

nodes.summary: A natural number $n$ is a Giuga number if it is composite (that is, $n \ge 2$ and $n$ is not prime) and $p$ divides $n/p - 1$ for every prime divisor $p$ of $n$.
nodes.title: Giuga number

nodes.summary: A natural number $n$ is practical if $n > 0$ and every integer $m$ with $1 \le m \le n$ is the sum of a set of distinct positive divisors of $n$.
nodes.title: Practical number

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 2$ be a natural number and put $p = 3 \cdot 2^n - 1$, $q = 3 \cdot 2^{n-1} - 1$ and $r = 9 \cdot 2^{2n-1} - 1$. If $p$, $q$ and $r$ are all prime, then $2^n p q < 2^n r$, the sum of the proper divisors of $2^n p q$ equals $2^n r$, and the sum of the proper divisors of $2^n r$ equals $2^n p q$; that is, $2^n p q$ and $2^n r$ are distinct amicable numbers.
nodes.title: Thābit ibn Qurra's theorem

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
